description: TikTok Video Search: search public TikTok videos by keyword or hashtag. Per video the caption, creator handle, name, verification and followers, plays, likes, comments, shares, cover image link, time and URL in the shared social schema; next_cursor gives the next page. Trend and hashtag research. Bad input is free; not found or no match is not charged. Price: $0.02 per successful call, paid over x402 (USDC on Base); pass the payment in _meta["x402/payment"].
